entities.name: The Abyss
entities.description: A plane populated by demons; the Pit is part of it.

entities.name: The Wretched
entities.description: Beings reputed to come from the Abyss who enslave the wills of enemies.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Died battling Ravidel in the Abyss.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Banished the evil creature Ur-Drago to the Abyss.

entities.name: Ur-Drago
entities.description: Evil creature banished to the Abyss by Greensleeves.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Elder Demon who fought in the War in the Abyss and was freed by the Cabal's ritual.

entities.name: Cabal

entities.name: Kuberr
